strategies.name: buy_and_hold
strategies.description: Buy on the first day and hold until the end. The simplest benchmark strategy.

strategies.name: golden_cross
strategies.description: Buy on 50/200 MA golden cross, sell on death cross. Long-term trend strategy.

strategies.name: ma_crossover
strategies.description: Buy when fast MA crosses above slow MA, sell when it crosses below.

strategies.name: macd
strategies.description: Buy when MACD line crosses above signal line, sell when it crosses below.

strategies.name: dual_ma_rsi
strategies.description: Buy when MA trend is up AND RSI is oversold. Sell when MA trend is down AND RSI is overbought.

strategies.name: ema_crossover
strategies.description: Buy when fast EMA crosses above slow EMA, sell when it crosses below. Faster than SMA crossover.

strategies.name: momentum_roc
strategies.description: Buy when Rate of Change exceeds threshold, sell when it drops below negative threshold.

strategies.name: adx_trend
strategies.description: Buy when ADX shows strong trend and +DI > -DI, sell when trend weakens or reverses.

strategies.name: parabolic_sar
strategies.description: Buy when SAR flips below price (uptrend), sell when SAR flips above price (downtrend).

strategies.name: keltner
strategies.description: Buy on upper channel breakout (trend following), sell on lower channel breakdown.

strategies.name: breakout
strategies.description: Buy on N-day high breakout, sell on M-day low breakdown. Trend-following breakout strategy.

strategies.name: rsi
strategies.description: Buy when RSI drops below oversold level, sell when it rises above overbought level.

strategies.name: bollinger
strategies.description: Buy when price touches lower band, sell when price touches upper band (mean reversion).

strategies.name: stochastic
strategies.description: Buy when %K crosses above %D in oversold zone, sell when crosses below in overbought zone.

strategies.name: vwap
strategies.description: Buy when price drops below VWAP by threshold, sell when price rises above VWAP by threshold.

params.name: buy_threshold
params.description: Buy when price is N% below VWAP

params.name: sell_threshold
params.description: Sell when price is N% above VWAP
